vendor: ByteDance Volcengine Ark Coding Plan (Doubao / Seed), Beijing region
status_note: Not tested by us. Everything here is copied from the vendor's pages on the dates given; run `python -m rak.models control doubao` before relying on it. Mainland-China platform: its terms were not checked.

claude_code.why: min: the kit's hooks need onFailure: block (2.1.295+). pin: the version the kit was last developed against (2026-11-01); not tested with this endpoint by us.

limits.text: the same endpoint also serves glm-5.3, deepseek-v4-* and kimi-k3 / kimi-k3.1-pro; a model name of Auto is not accepted (console only)
do not use the /api/v3 base URL: it does not use Coding Plan quota and is billed extra
telemetry goes to the base URL and uses quota unless CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC is set; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL should match the main model
Web Search needs a separate console service and makes extra model calls
Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models; treat every Claude Code upgrade as untested until the positive control passes

data_policy.verified: not checked: mainland platform terms were out of scope. BytePlus (international) states no use without prior authorization (read through a search summary) but is a different endpoint
